name: Jira
description: Mirror your Jira Cloud issues into hive's board and keep them in sync both ways: sign in with Atlassian, pull your issues on any workflow, and every status change goes back to Jira as a legal transition.

settings.label: Scoped API token
settings.description: For heavy use, or when your org blocks the sign-in. Next to the sign-in, it serves what the sign-in can't (all fields, JQL checks, history). Read only by this plugin's service.

settings.label: Cloud ID (API token only)
settings.description: Only when it can't be looked up: open https://<your-site>/_edge/tenant_info and copy cloudId.

settings.label: API-token connection
settings.description: Set when you connect with an API token in the Jira tile: the email, site and cloud ID it uses. Clear it to disconnect.

settings.label: Atlassian sign-in
settings.description: Set by Sign in with Atlassian; clear it to sign out.

settings.label: JQL (when Pull is My own JQL)
Take several transitions without asking
settings.description: When Jira has no direct transition to the status you chose, hive takes the shortest way (3 at most) on its own if none of them has a screen. Off: it asks first.

settings.label: Send your comments to Jira
settings.description: With Send to Jira on Status and comments: what you write on an issue in hive.

settings.label: Send agents' plans and summaries to Jira
settings.description: An agent's comment that starts with Plan or Summary. Its progress notes are never sent.

settings.label: Send PR opened and merged to Jira
Atlassian calls per hour
settings.description: Your org may share one hourly limit for the Atlassian MCP server.

tools.label: Jira
tools.description: Sync status, workflow mapping, scope, browse and conflicts for this workspace's Jira link.
